decode_image: decode image bytes to a numpy array using TensorFlow image decoding
png_to_jpeg: convert a PNG image in bytes format to JPEG with configurable quality
jpeg_cmyk_to_rgb: convert a JPEG CMYK image in bytes to RGB JPEG with configurable quality
ffmpeg_run: run an ffmpeg command with arguments, optional stdin, and timeout
create_thumbnail: create a PIL thumbnail from a numpy array with optional colormap application
